name: capital-finterm
description: Capital-FinTerm: the Capital area's capital-markets terminal as an Android app behind the SuperApp's Cloud > Lnktree row. Six tabs on the shared bottom nav, FI | EQ | EX | NW | PM | MY-PM, each entry a dashboard drawn from a DECLARED source (data/sources.json): Cloud-Fincept / fin_api on the private mesh first (with a Start / Stop / Restart control for its container), the key-free public sources (FRED, DBnomics, IMF, World Bank, GDELT) as fallback, and dashed placeholders where a source needs a key you add in Config > Sources (stored encrypted on the phone). MY-PM is a simple local holdings list. Every figure shown is what its source returned, with its date and attribution.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps. KEY LOCATION: Shared/Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + Shared/Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/signing.secrets.yaml.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.
auto_update._doc_enabled: Off because this app compiles no libs:updater: the Store updates it, as it does Cloud Calc and Cloud Search.

ui._doc: #868 THE nav declaration (libs:bottomnav NavDecl) of Capital-FinTerm: the sections on the bottom bar in order, a hidden Config (the gear of the first row: Sources, About) and a hidden About. #1335 ui.stacks[<section>] is the page of that section: a list of entries drawn by declared KIND (Pages.kt: entry, section_title, holdings, about, dashboard, sources). A `dashboard` entry (every FinTerm entry) has a title, a one-line subtitle and `dashboard`, the id of its dashboard in data/dashboards.json; the dashboard names its declared source(s) in data/sources.json (the catalog, with endpoints, auth, coverage and the tabs/entries each source feeds), so no address is typed in this file or in Kotlin. The `sources` kind is Config > Sources: the catalog by category and the user's own API keys, stored encrypted on the phone. An `entry` (still drawn for the other Lnktree apps' shape) has ONE declared source for its target: `site` (the label of a link of aa_cloud-superapp/data/linktree.json), `registry` (a code of aa_cloud-superapp/build.json ui.app_urls.registry_sites) or `repo` + `path`; app/build.gradle resolves them at BUILD time from the SuperApp's own declarations and bakes UI_TARGETS_B64. A `planned` entry has a note and no source and is drawn greyed. Market figures are never declared here: a dashboard shows what its source returns, with its date and attribution.
